metadata.othernotes:
What? You need NOTES on me? What don't you get? I'm evil, I've got extendable mechanical arms with numerous gadgets stored inside, and my overbite is my most CHARMING feature and is NOT a blemish.

I'm not dumb enough to tell you my weeknesses, so don't bother asking. I'd never admit if you guessed one, either. I'm always thinking several steps ahead, so I might as well tell you I don't have any weeknesses at all.

Don't think you can talk behind my back in another language. I speak SEVERAL. Nulla è reale, tutto è lecito.

I've been evil all of my life. I'm sure you can imagine a little toddler me, knocking over other kids' block towers and stealing their jiuce boxes. And yes, I AM human. My hair and skin are both natural.

Would you believe me if I said I'm a people person? Well it's true, I just love screwing with people more. In fact, I rarely actually kill anyone. It's much more fun to make you beg for death, and then deny you the pleasure.

As much as you might want me gone, the world NEEDS people like me. Humans NEED people to direct their hate towards, an enemy in common to rally against. You can't have good without bad.

case.name: About Me
case.description: I'm a very infamous villain and daughter to the (neutral) scientist who made robot prosthetics possible. I live and breathe evil.

case.name: Arm Origins 1
case.description: When taking off my hoodie, I will ask what others think caused me to lose my arms. Pay attention, 'cause I will NOT respond to targets directed at the "stripping" phase here.

case.name: Arm Origins 2
case.description: I will either tease the table by not sharing the story behind my arms, or explain that I cut them off intentionally to make myself more evil.

case.name: Arm Origins 3
case.description: If I explained the story behind my arms, in the next game I'm in, I may point out that I already explained it to the player, or give a completely different story.

case.name: Cheater
case.description: When I have to reveal my chest, I may also reveal that I've been cheating the whole time, and won't stop cheating either.
